result.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
result.summary: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

AI.brief_summary: 提出元智能体 Strategist，把推理流程写成可复用、可执行的代码蓝图并汇成策略库；面对新任务时检索相关蓝图、生成候选策略、在真实样本上测试并据结果修订，在 30 个基准上以约低 39% 的推理成本取得与最强基线相当或更优的精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 不含视觉或多模态成分，但将推理过程显式化为可搜索、可测试、可修订的程序，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等推理调度策略的自动搜索与成本—精度权衡提供可供核查的方法线索。
